title: Leo & The Lost Library Book: Returning What You Borrow!

lines.text: Leo borrowed the library's coolest treasure: The Giant Pop-Up T-Rex Encyclopedia!
lines.caps: Leo borrowed the library's *TREASURE: | The Giant Pop-Up *T-REX | *ENCYCLOPEDIA!

lines.text: Be gentle with this book, Leo, the librarian said. Others are waiting to read it!
lines.caps: Be gentle with this *BOOK, | the librarian said. Others are *WAITING | to read *IT!

lines.text: Leo read it under the oak tree, but when his dog barked, he ran off and forgot it!
lines.caps: Leo read it under the *TREE, | but ran off and *FORGOT | it on the *GRASS!

lines.text: HISSS! The garden sprinkler clicked on, spraying water toward the paper pop-ups!
lines.caps: *HISSS! The garden sprinkler clicked *ON, | spraying water toward the *PAPER | *PAGES!

lines.text: Leo gasped, sprinted across the lawn, and slid to shield the book with his jacket!
lines.caps: Leo gasped, *SPRINTED | across the lawn, and shielded the *BOOK | with his *JACKET!

lines.text: He brought it inside, dried every drop with a soft towel, and checked every dinosaur!
lines.caps: He brought it *INSIDE, | dried every drop, and checked every *DINOSAUR | *CAREFULLY!

lines.text: The next morning, Leo returned it promptly with a polite thank you note!
lines.caps: The next morning, Leo returned it *PROMPTLY | with a polite *THANK YOU | *NOTE!

lines.text: Treating borrowed things with great care builds a golden reputation that lasts!
lines.caps: Treating borrowed things with *CARE | builds a golden reputation that *LASTS!

lines.text: Be responsible and reliable—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
